description: This file defines a SettingsController class for managing user settings related to streaming quality and subtitles in a Flutter application. It interacts with a caching service to load and save user preferences, and notifies listeners of state changes.

classes.name: SettingsController
classes.description: Controller for managing streaming quality and subtitle preferences, with functionality to load from and save to cache, and notify UI of changes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads user preferences from cache and updates internal state.

methods.name: setQuality
methods.description: Sets streaming quality preference and updates cache.

methods.name: setSubtitlesDefault
methods.description: Sets subtitles default preference and updates cache.
